name: Godot Addon CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Restore godot/ directory
        run: |
          git checkout HEAD~1 -- godot/
        shell: bash

      - name: Remove amy_midi.c from build
        run: |
          rm -f src/amy_midi.c
        shell: bash

      - name: Add MIDI stubs to amy_platform_stubs.c
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' >> src/amy_platform_stubs.c
          // MIDI stubs for Windows
          int amy_midi_init() { return 0; }
          int amy_midi_play(int track) { return 0; }
          void amy_midi_stop() {}
          EOF
        shell: bash

      - name: Configure and build with CMake
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsOrSettingsJson: 'CMakeLists.txt'
          cmakeListsTxtPath: '.'
          cmakeSettingsJsonPath: ''
          cmakeToolchainPath: ''
          useVcpkgToolchainFile: false
          vcpkgTriplet: ''
          cmakeBuildType: Release
          cmakeGenerator: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && 'Visual Studio 17 2022' || 'Ninja' }}
          buildDirectory: build
          cmakeAppendedArgs: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && '-A x64' || '' }}
          configurationRegexFilter: ''
          ninjaPath: ''
          ninjaDownloadUrl: ''
          cmakeWrapperCommand: ''
          buildWithCMake: true

      - name: Zip addon output
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cd build
          zip -r ../../dist/amy-addon-${{ matrix.os }}.zip *
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-addon-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: dist/amy-addon-${{ matrix.os }}.zip
